html:
The Montenegro earthquake struck the coast of Montenegro on 15 April 1979, killing about a hundred people in Montenegro and dozens more in Albania.

Its centre lay offshore between Bar and Ulcinj. Old Bar was wrecked, and Kotor, Budva and many coastal villages were badly damaged. Tens of thousands lost their homes. Yugoslavia and foreign donors paid to rebuild, and Kotor was put on the World Heritage list in danger the same year. The restoration of the old towns, finished over decades, made the coast a base of the tourism on which Montenegro's economy now depends.
sum: The Montenegro earthquake struck the coast of Montenegro on 15 April 1979, killing about a hundred people in Montenegro and dozens more in Albania.
